title: Normalized immersion Weil operation clause packages
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. The immersion restriction and open-extension clauses use the standard constructible hearts and canonical cohomology comparisons [lem-a1-constructible-pullback-t-exact], the actual geometric point fibres and local operators [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace], and the normalized coefficient action [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action]. Define ZlWeilExactOperation to record the exact heart restriction and Weil cohomology comparisons with their carrier equations; define ZlWeilLocalOperators to record natural operators normalized at every finite coefficient stage; define ZlImmersionPullback to record the inverse-image clause, actual residue maps and normalized Frobenius-equivariant stalks; and define ZlOpenExtension to record the open compact-support clause, normalized adjunction mate and unit, inside-open comparison and outside zero stalks. All functors, comparison formulas and fields are exactly those of the existing statement of [lem-zl-immersion-weil-local-behavior], with no additional choices or changed data.
